Eötvös Ferenc Farkas Ligeti Liszt Leo Weiner This is an alphabetical list of Hungarian composers . [ 1 ] This is a dynamic list and may never be able to satisfy particular standards for completeness. You can help by editing the page to add missing items, with references to reliable sources .
